text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "refines", "reason": "Saying the launch is on track for October is consistent with an October 15th date; it adds status without changing the date."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Marcus pushing the date is a past event that cannot be undone; the launch being on track now is a separate status update."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The customs module being in scope and the launch being on track for October can both be true at once."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Sarah giving Joy a September 1st date in April is a fixed past event; the target later moved to October, which is already captured elsewhere."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Joy's test-coverage preference and the launch being on track are independent; both can hold at the same time."}]}
